text: CITY OF CHICAGO HEIGHTS CHICAGO HEIGHTS, ILLINOIS 60411 October 15, 1971 Mr. Henry M. Yamanaka Mobility Studies Engineer State Division of Highways Room 907 - 300 North State Street Chicago, Illinois 60610 Mobility Studies Re: Lincoln Highway Improvement Cicero Ave. to Chicago Rd. Dear Mr. Yamanaka: This is a follow-up of Mayor Bonick's letter of September 14, and in response to your letter of July 8, 1971 concerning closing Sunnyside Avenue. All of your proposals submitted with your letter are based on the assumption that Sunnyside would be vacated. The City will vacate Sunnyside provided it receives just compensation for the vacation, either from the State or the School District. This is an area of 8100 square feet. Any proposal you wish to submit must be approved by the City Council. Very truly yours, CITY OF CHICAGO HEIGHTS Frank Hunki FRANK E. GLOWACKI Corporation Counsel B-10 FEG:CN
